runtimeCheckpoint: Highline: The Rooftop Signal. Direct selection from the main game. See FUTURE-DIRECTION.md and HIGHLINE.md.
changes: Two genuinely taller playable buildings: Print Exchange 17.2 m and Radio Tower 23.6 m, with switchback stairs, supported grapple landings, and crossings at 10.8 m and 17.2 m.
Immediately available Highline mission: meet Sal, discover upper archive evidence, survey routes, restore the rooftop repeater, bring a recording home and receive 240 campaign credits exactly once.
Lower-crossing patrols are optional: the upper crossing bypasses them; restoring the repeater stands them down with a persistent green indicator.
Save validation and recovery support the new altitude without changing the original chapter/layout identity, city/resident/Watch ledgers or old campaign gates.
Direction and recovery notes remain next to the game; all five previous cases, original neighborhood, controls and eight XR views are retained.
Interaction captions render independently on the floor and disappear completely after 2000 ms, with complete text available in Recent interaction text.
A live mission map updates during normal XR play without a raised-hand gesture, including the original city and Lantern Ward.
Diorama box is three times taller by default; menu size, overall diorama size, vertical window height and floor-map size can be adjusted independently.
Late floor-reference acquisition corrects an estimated height; the UI remains outside the game world and never parents to the headset.
Gold task marker plus cyan next-entrance cue, supported route map and dismount/dock guidance; existing shortcuts and water states affect the suggestion without moving or advancing the player.
Reconcile the competing Field Desk physical left/right vehicle-trigger option into the existing console; preserve current primary-hand defaults and all on-foot/Courier/Xbox controls.
Remove fourteen obsolete writer/duplicate workflow wrappers; retain all unique tests in three existing read-only master workflows.
Native XR page follows Xbox/keyboard focus, with a visible focus marker and a direct Choose a mission jump; Pause and cancel-first restoration remain unchanged.
Native mission buttons show the next saved task before selection; the HUD names the active campaign tool rather than stale Watch equipment.
Summonable floor rotunda or free-controller menu with saved height, distance, scale and native raised buttons.
Compact free-hand or floor objective/map card; neither HUD nor menu is attached to the headset.
Non-overlapping map and wrapped objective, equipment and controls; complete speed/brake hints and mount-specific dismissal text.
Single-hand/controller floor fallback and correct UI ordering above translucent world effects.
Explicit Action-profile primary-trigger vehicle speed; on-foot, Courier and Xbox controls preserved.
Existing city, Lantern Ward, eight native modes, legacy saves and independent reward ledgers retained.
